description: During the Texas Instruments account-pursuit-map run, the Chase subagent reported 'no Dynamics connector was available' and fell back to M365 email/calendar search plus Clay lookup as a proxy for a CRM check, leaving the engagement shape (cold vs. active-but-underleveraged) unconfirmed and flagged as an open item.
correction: CRM is accessible in this environment via M365 (Dynamics is exposed through M365-connected tooling) or via Chrome, which is already logged into CRM. A subagent should not conclude a connector is unavailable and substitute a weaker proxy signal without first attempting CRM access through M365 or Chrome browser automation.
